plain: The state of being unable to pay one's debts.

webster.text: Inability of a person to pay all his debts; or the state of wanting property sufficient for such payment; as a merchant's insolvency.

example.quote: JOHNSON supposed the meaning to be that Judgments in one State should be the ground of actions in other States, & that acts of the Legislatures should be included, for the sake of Acts of insolvency &c.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, August 29, 1787
